html:
Specialised Gastrointestinal Care at Silver Touch Hospitals

Gastrointestinal health issues may impact your comfort, nutrition, and overall wellness. At Silver Touch Hospitals, our specialised gastroenterology team provides accurate, patient-focused care for a broad spectrum of gastrointestinal conditions, spanning the oesophagus, stomach, intestines, liver, pancreas, and gallbladder.

Being one of the most reliable chains of gastroenterology hospital in Ahmedabad, we mix expert consultants with the latest diagnostics to cure any and all from chronic acidity and ulcers to liver disease, inflammatory bowel disorders, and cancers of the gastrointestinal system.

Expert Team Headed by the Best Gastroenterologist in Ahmedabad

Our gastroenterology department is headed by very experienced consultants with extensive clinical knowledge for each case.

In case you’re experiencing abdominal pain, weight loss without any explanation, indigestion, jaundice, or rectal bleeding, our experts will quickly identify the cause and initiate the appropriate treatment.

Being a complete gastrologist hospital in Ahmedabad, we provide:

  • Treatment for liver diseases, hepatitis, and cirrhosis
  • Treatment for pancreatitis, gallstones, and bile duct problems
  • Diagnosis and treatment of Crohn’s disease and ulcerative colitis
  • Screening and surveillance for GI cancer
  • Infections and motility disorders of the digestive tract

Best Liver Specialist Hospital in Ahmedabad

Silver Touch Hospitals is also known as the best liver specialist hospital in Ahmedabad, which also treats an entire range of liver diseases, from fatty liver and viral hepatitis to cirrhosis and liver failure.

Our consultants interact closely with dietitians and internal medicine specialists to create liver-friendly care plans that emphasise long-term recovery and quality of life.

We’re also a patients’ referral centre for complex hepatic assessments or pre-transplant care for liver transplant in Ahmedabad.

Our expert gastro physicians and gastroenterologists see patients across Ahmedabad, with dedicated care available at our Nirnaynagar-Ranip and Satellite-Prahladnagar branches.

Accuracy of Diagnosis at Our Endoscopy Hospital, Ahmedabad

Effective GI treatment lies in precise diagnosis. As a well-equipped endoscopy hospital in Ahmedabad, we offer:

  • Upper GI endoscopy (OGD)
  • Colonoscopy and biopsy
  • Sigmoidoscopy
  • Endoscopic polyp removal
  • ERCP (Endoscopic Retrograde Cholangiopancreatography)

Our procedures are done using state-of-the-art video-endoscopy equipment to provide close-up imaging and minimal discomfort.

Our endoscopy hospital serves patients from Nirnaynagar-Ranip, Satellite-Prahladnagar, and across Ahmedabad.

Why Silver Touch Hospitals?

  • Multispecialty team handling
  • Clear treatment plan
  • Rapid reporting and diagnosis
  • Sterile, infection-free endoscopy suites
  • Personalised diet and recovery assistance

With decades of caring experience, Silver Touch Hospitals is expanding as a top Ahmedabad liver hospital, providing timely treatment and long-term digestive health care.

faqs.q: When do I need to consult a gastroenterologist?
faqs.a: If you are having ongoing bloating, belly ache, vomiting, constipation, diarrhoea, or unintentional weight loss, it’s better to meet with a gastroenterologist in Ahmedabad for assessment.
Endoscopy is generally not painful. You might feel some discomfort, but sedatives usually help you relax while the procedure is being carried out.

faqs.q: Do you perform colon cancer screening?
faqs.a: Yes, we offer colonoscopy screening and surveillance for patients at risk of colorectal cancer, either by family history or age.

faqs.q: Can I have a second opinion for liver disease here?
faqs.a: Yes. Our liver consultants provide second opinions and interpretations of outside test reports to ensure that you make informed decisions.

faqs.q: How do I schedule an appointment?
faqs.a: Just give your closest Silver Touch Hospitals branch a call or fill in the web form to arrange an appointment with our experts.
